countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Apple storefront country codes, e.g. us, gb, de, in, br, au. One chart per country per genre.

genres.title: Genres
genres.description: Podcast genres to pull. "all" is the overall chart.

topN.title: Chart depth
topN.description: How many ranks to pull per chart (Apple serves up to 200).

trackPodcastIds.title: Track only these podcasts (optional)
trackPodcastIds.description: Apple podcast ids (e.g. 1200361736 or id1200361736). When set, only these shows produce rows; shows not in a chart produce a FREE rank:null row so you still get the answer.

compareWithPrevious.title: Compare with previous run
compareWithPrevious.description: Remember ranks between runs and report previousRank, rankChange, isNew and droppedOff. Turn on with a schedule for daily movement tracking.
